checks: Fresh journal starts with a neutral anatomical figure and no phantom chest selection
Recorded bench activity colors the chest without selecting it; historical records remain intact
Actual touch selects paired chest paths; a second activation deselects without changing training color
Keyboard selection highlights only the intended group and restores focus to the same anatomical path
Back view exposes glutes, hamstrings, calves, erectors and distinct upper-back/lat/trapezius shapes using saved canonical contributions
Reopening the map clears ephemeral selection while preserving historical muscle statistics
Custom weekly scheduling generates multiple weekdays until an inclusive end date and preserves legacy one-time entries
Recurrence and skip/restore exceptions survive reload without deleting or duplicating the series
Editing one occurrence reschedules only that stable occurrence identity
Future scope splits the rule at the chosen occurrence without rewriting past rule segments
Entire-series edits change schedule fields while leaving every completed workout unchanged
Changing the calendar first day preserves actual recurring weekdays and times
Starting and completing a future scheduled workout associates exactly one occurrence while preserving actual completion date and future sessions
Stopping a recurring schedule removes future generated occurrences and retains completed history
Master notification preference persists and turning it off preserves default timing, individual reminders and recurring schedules
Real browser permission states explain denial and permission is requested only through the intentional control
A due active-app reminder is delivered in-app and through the real worker notification API exactly once
Turning reminders off closes controlled pending notifications; reenabling never floods or repeats delivered reminders
Muscle map, recurrence calendar and Notifications fit all six required widths in both themes without horizontal clipping
Repeated navigation remains stable; workout logging, recurrence, preferences and the new map survive offline reload
limitations: Actual Chromium with mobile viewport/touch and native notification APIs. Physical Android/iPhone installation and closed-app delivery are not certified.
